candidates.change_summary: Change owner() to return the zero address instead of the stored _owner, altering observable return value.
Require newOwner is non-zero removed so transferOwnership allows setting owner to zero without revert.
Change onlyOwner guard to allow anyone to call transferOwnership by removing the modifier invocation.
Invert onlyOwner check so the function reverts unless caller is NOT the owner, preventing owner from calling transferOwnership.

Change setRewardDistributor to require caller is current rewardDistributor instead of onlyOwner, causing rewardDistributor to be updateable only by the current distributor (different authorization), which can change the stored value after a call.
Change setRewardDistributor to assign rewardDistributor to msg.sender instead of the provided _distributor, so the stored value becomes the caller after a call.
Change setRewardDistributor to revert unconditionally (delete assignment) by requiring false, preventing any change to rewardDistributor after call.
Change setRewardDistributor to emit the event but do not assign rewardDistributor (delete assignment statement), so value remains unchanged after the call.
Modify onlyOwner to allow any caller (remove the ownership check), permitting anyone to call setRewardDistributor and thus changing rewardDistributor value after a call by non-owners.
